sections.description: Integration between WordPress and Bottle360 e-commerce APIs.
sections.changelog:
4.5.13

Smoother club memberships and saved cards.

  • Saved cards show up right away when you add or remove one, no refresh needed.
  • Club members on pickup now see "Pickup" and their pickup location instead of a shipping address.
  • Members can update their club card or add a new billing or shipping address right from their membership page, and any problem shows in the form.
  • Safer "Match my site" styling in the Styling Studio.
